meta.name: simplified-governance-establishment
meta.description: Use when establishing control over a newly conquered territory or winning popular support quickly. Simplifies harsh legal codes to three basic laws (约法三章) following Liu Bang's model at Xianyang to build rapid legitimacy.

copy.tagline: 用约法三章快速建立新领地统治合法性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接管新区域需要快速获得民众支持
copy.tagline_en: Establish rapid legitimacy in newly conquered territories with three basic laws
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gain popular support after taking over a new region

howto.what: 当你接管新领地或需要快速获得民众支持时，Claude会帮你简化法律至三条，并展示克制和仁慈，以建立合法性和信任。
howto.when: 在你描述需要控制新征服领土或赢得民心时触发。

say.text: 我刚攻下这座城，如何快速让百姓支持我？
say.note: Claude会建议执行约法三章步骤。

say.text: 废除旧法，只保留三条基本法律可行吗？
say.note: Claude会解释简化法律的逻辑。

say.text: 军队应该驻扎在城内还是城外？
say.note: Claude会建议驻扎城外以示克制。

howto.what_en: When you need to establish control over a newly conquered territory or win popular support, Claude will simplify the legal code to three basic laws and demonstrate restraint and benevolence to build legitimacy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe needing to control a newly conquered territory or quickly win popular support.

say_en.text: I just conquered this city. How do I gain the people's support quickly?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest following the simplified governance steps.

say_en.text: Can I abolish the old harsh laws and keep only three basic ones?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the rationale behind simplifying laws.

say_en.text: Should the troops be stationed inside or outside the city?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend stationing outside to show restraint.
